request.prompt:
Create one isolated, full-body game-character production prototype for Mass Effect — Armax Relay Clash, using the attached original game reference as the visual authority. Faithfully reproduce the specific original model, its anatomy, proportions, materials, color blocking, equipment placement and asymmetry. Detailed realistic game-render finish, crisp readable silhouette, even studio lighting with subtle material highlights. Output exactly ONE character and ONE view, with the complete head, body, every limb, weapon and feet inside the image and generous transparent padding on all sides. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no ground plane, no cast floor shadow, no scene, no frame, no contact sheet, no text, no captions, no publisher logos. The attached sheet is a reference for the single figure, not a layout to reproduce. Preserve model-side asymmetry; do not mirror the reference. Do not add equipment, insignia, effects or redesigned parts. This is a still pose, not an animation sheet.

Subject: Cannibal, Mass Effect 3 standard base model WITHOUT the temporary armored combat reinforcement. Use the top-left three-quarter view facing image-right as the pose and silhouette guide. Preserve the large asymmetric upper back and shoulders, gray-brown organic surfaces, narrow mechanical lower legs and feet, oversized open alien mouth, small cold blue implanted facial lights, blue-lit circular abdominal mechanism and its tubing. The integrated cylindrical mechanical cannon replaces the creature's anatomical RIGHT forearm; the anatomical LEFT arm remains the thin organic clawed arm. Match those exact sides and do not mirror. Keep the recognizable small secondary face embedded high on the anatomical right shoulder as shown. Neutral standing menace, not a scene of injury or feeding; no added wounds, blood spray or effects. All feet and arm-cannon tips visible.
